name: Leave requests
summary: Employees ask for leave; approvers approve or reject it, and an approved request gets an approval letter.

dataHandling.purpose: Recording leave requests and their approval
dataHandling.retention: As long as the organization keeps its leave requests

changelog: 1.1.0: unpaid leave needs a reason; a calendar of approved leave. No new trigger: nothing to turn on.

parameters.label: Employees
parameters.help: Everyone who asks for leave, approvers included: the app is listed only for this group. Must be a different group from Approvers (the same person may be in both). Give its members a role with entity.read, entity.list and entity.write: a role does not come from a group.

parameters.label: Approvers
parameters.help: The people who approve or reject leave requests. They see every request. Must be a different group from Employees, and each approver must also be in Employees to see the app. Give them a role with entity.read, entity.list and entity.write.

parameters.label: Automation principal
parameters.help: The service principal the Approve leave workflow runs as. Give it a role with entity.read, entity.list and entity.write, add it to the Automation group, and issue it no credential.

parameters.label: Automation group
parameters.help: Holds the automation principal and one dedicated account that never signs in (setup needs a person in a group), and no one else: its members may move any request to approved or rejected.
